title: How Adam Robinson bootstrapped Retention.com to $22M ARR and rebuilt with a free product and LinkedIn
summary: Adam describes his journey from failed email products to a free, plg tool (RB2B), and why personal-brand distribution beats outbound. He covers category creation, a weekly LinkedIn/Zoom event as a feedback loop, word of mouth as a prerequisite, and why outbound response rates are collapsing.

principles.text: Word of mouth is the gate: without it no channel works; with it, everything amplifies.
principles.quote: if you don't have Word of Mouth nothing works you know like we're sitting here picking channels right it's like well what's the maximum low hanging fruit that we can execute on

principles.text: Personal brand content compounds; a founder's face on an event outperforms company branding.
principles.quote: it may be 10x on any individual thing that you do but these this all this stuff compounds so if everything is 10x then in a year it's 10,000x

principles.text: Run a weekly recurring event to take the market's temperature and sharpen narrative.
principles.quote: the best feedback loop is this weekly event

principles.text: Coin and own a category or workflow; saying you're part of a new workflow helps even if it isn't fully real.
principles.quote: it's so helpful to just do this category creation thing I think even if it's not real right it's like so helpful to say that you're part of some new workflow that people are not doing

principles.text: Build your buyers while building the product; talk to many prospects early so you quit cheaply if it's wrong.
principles.quote: you have got to be building your buyers as you're building your product before you have it because software is so hard to get right

principles.text: A free offer can be a positioning moat; a small megaphone-backed company gains more from free than from midmarket sales.
principles.quote: I have this huge megaphone and it's got scale but a mid-market sales operation does not have the advantages a scale has if I had a free offer it would help me a lot more
